Both rest flat at the box bottom, soles down, aligned left to right with toes pointing left in the image; both grippers are open and have released the shoes.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping flatter sidewalls below the laces near the sole across the shoe width, opening slightly wider than that section. Confirm the fingers surround both sides before closing to avoid gripping only laces or tongue or closing empty above the shoe.
- The shoe on the left currently points to the right. When turning it, lift the entire shoe clear of the table and above the box rim, leaving room for the toe and heel to rotate without brushing the box wall.
- While lowering into the box, monitor clearance between the toe, heel, gripper and box walls. If another shoe is inside, avoid pushing fingertips into the narrow gap between them and displacing the placed shoe.
- Release gradually after the shoe sole is supported by the box bottom. When withdrawing, avoid the shoe opening and laces to reduce slipping, tipping, or shifting it with the gripper.
